shared_elements: incised linear detail used as surface texture (garment folds / hatched lines)
justification: A depicts a procession of bearded human figures in profile, robed, holding objects and touching one another in a narrative relief scene, while B shows only an all-over abstract geometric field of hatched chevron/zigzag triangles with no figures, creatures or objects at all. The only faint commonality is the use of fine parallel incised lines, which in A serve as drapery folds and in B as pure ornament, so nothing iconographic is shared.
